        Draft this email in this person's authentic voice and email register.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Lucia Mendes, Senior Accountant, Tax (mid).
Senior tax accountant: partnerships and the individual returns, K-1 season quarterback, keeps the Stonebridge relationship humming.
Personality: Composed under load, dry wit, hates loose ends.
Email register: Crisp and cordial; signs 'Lucia'.
Chat register: Short, precise, occasionally deadpan.
Working hours: 08:30-17:30

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant [Name] – Action Required

Gabriel, Lucia,

We need to close the CAM reconciliation dispute with [Tenant Name] before the end of this quarter. This has been outstanding too long, and I need a firm date for resolution.

Please provide, by end of day Friday:
1. A line-item breakdown of the disputed charges, with supporting documentation.
2. The specific objections raised by the tenant, in writing.
3. A proposed settlement range, with your recommended position.

Once I have that, I will review and we can schedule a call to finalize. I want this off the books by the 15th.

Confirm receipt and your availability for a short call on Monday.

Evan

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant [Name] – Action Required

Hi Evan,

Thanks for the nudge on this—I agree it's been open too long and I want it closed before the 15th.

To confirm: I have the line-item breakdown and the tenant's written objections already compiled. I'll pull the supporting docs together and send everything to you by end of day Friday, along with a proposed settlement range and my recommended position.

Monday works for a short call—I have a window from 9:00 to 9:30, or after 11:00 if that's better. Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant [Name] – Action Required

Gabriel,

Good to have your confirmation. I'll expect your full package by Friday COB—line items, supporting docs, tenant objections, and your settlement recommendation.

Let's take the 9:00–9:30 slot Monday. I'll dial in from my end; you can send a calendar invite with the line.

One thing: I want this closed by the 15th, no exceptions. If anything shifts on your side, flag it to me before Friday so we can adjust.

Evan

---

From: Lucia Mendes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant [Name] – Action Required

Hi Evan,

Following up on Gabriel's note—I'll be supporting him in pulling the package together and will make sure the numbers tie out before Friday's deadline. The tenant's objections have been logged, and I'll cross-check the line items against the supporting docs to confirm nothing is missing.

For Monday, 9:00–9:30 works on my end as well, and I'll be on the call with Gabriel to walk through the settlement range and answer any questions.

We'll flag any issues before Friday if anything shifts—but as it stands, we're on track for the 15th.

Best,
Lucia

[[ ## intent ## ]]
Confirm support for Gabriel on the CAM reconciliation dispute and ensure the tenant objections are logged for Friday delivery

[[ ## established_facts ## ]]
Confirms Lucia's support for Gabriel in delivering the CAM reconciliation package by Friday COB, verifies tenant objections are logged and line items will be cross-checked, and confirms availability for the Monday 9:00-9:30 call with Evan.

[[ ## relevant_knowledge ## ]]
None.
